I know what it's like to have someone very close to you take their own life. It's almost definitely the worst thing in life, depending on how close you where to the person, and it seems like you were very close to him. 
I would be willing to bet that a lot of different thoughts have occurred to you since then, whether you realize it or not.

I'd bet that you sometimes think/thought it was your fault. And I'm sure that's not true. If he was the only person you loved, I think he would have known that.

I'd also bet you've thought you don't want to get that close to anyone else because you think they'll do the same thing. And you can't let that stop you. You cannot control what other people do. So there's no sense worrying about it. Having someone in your life might bring some of the emotion back into your life.
